items.difficulty_reason: Characterisation of quasi-coherent modules testing only on slice sites for the three topologies: assuming any of (1)-(3), for an object x over U the restriction x^*F = x^{-1}F lives on (Sch/U)_tau, is quasi-coherent by the definition of quasi-coherent modules on a ringed site, and is the sheaf associated to a quasi-coherent module by Descent, equivalence-quasi-coherent; the converse direction rebuilds the sheaf condition for all three topologies via Descent, sheaf-condition-holds and the structure-sheaf definition. Retained author proof at lines 1839-1860.
